content: # Frequently Asked Questions — LexTech Support ## What is LexTech? LexTech is a cloud-based project management software that helps teams collaborate, track tasks, and manage deadlines in real time. ## How do I create an account? To create a LexTech account: 1. Go to www.lextech.com/signup 2. Enter your work email address 3. Choose a password that is at least 8 characters long 4. Click the "Create Account" button 5. Check your email for a verification link and click it ## How much does LexTech cost? LexTech offers three pricing plans: - Free Plan: Up to 3 users, 5 projects, 1GB storage - Pro Plan: $12 per user per month, unlimited projects, 50GB storage - Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing, unlimited everything, dedicated support ## Can I cancel my subscription anytime? If you are not satisfied within the first 14 days, contact support@lextech.com for a full refund. No questions asked. ## What is NOT refundable The following are not eligible for refunds: - Subscriptions older than 14 days - Enterprise plan setup fees - Add-on purchases such as extra storage - Accounts that violated LexTech Terms of Service ## How to Request a Refund 1. content: # Security Policy — LexTech ## Password Requirements All LexTech passwords must meet these requirements: - Minimum 8 characters long - At least one uppercase letter - At least one number - At least one special character such as ! @ # $ - Cannot be the same as your last 5 passwords ## Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) LexTech strongly recommends enabling 2FA on all accounts. Enterprise plan accounts have mandatory 2FA enforced by default. To enable 2FA: 1. Go to Account Settings 2. Click Security 3. Click Enable Two-Factor Authentication 4. Choose SMS or Authenticator App 5. Follow the setup steps ## Data Encryption All data stored in LexTech is encrypted using AES-256 encryption. content: # Troubleshooting Guide — LexTech ## I cannot log into my account ### Reason 1: Wrong password If you forgot your password: 1. Go to www.lextech.com/login 2. Click "Forgot Password" 3. Enter your email address 4. Check your email for a reset link 5. Click the link and create a new password The reset link expires after 30 minutes. ### Reason 2: Account locked Your account gets locked after 5 failed login attempts. To unlock it, wait 15 minutes and try again, or contact support@lextech.com. ### Reason 3: Email not verified If you just created your account, check your inbox for a verification email. Check your spam folder if you do not see it. ## My dashboard is loading slowly This usually happens because of one of these reasons: - Too many browser tabs open — close unused tabs - Slow internet connection — check your connection speed - Browser
